abgleich.laeuft: Syncing the mailbox — the first run takes a few minutes.

abwesenheit.nur_wenn_es_laeuft: nexmail only answers while nexmail itself is running — not your computer, nexmail. While it is stopped, no out-of-office reply goes out. Your provider can usually do this on the mail server itself, independently of nexmail.
abwesenheit.bis_offen: Leave empty to keep it running until you switch it off.
abwesenheit.schleifenschutz: Every sender gets the note at most once. Mailing lists, other automated systems and delivery failures never get one.
abwesenheit.antworten_hinweis: Who has already received one. This is how you spot a loop before it gets embarrassing.
abwesenheit.fehler_ohne_text: No message, no reply. The sender would get an empty mail and think they broke something.
abwesenheit.fehler_zeitraum: The end is before the start.

anmeldung.code_text: Enter the six digits from your authenticator app.
anmeldung.wiederherstellung_text: One of your ten codes. It stops working afterwards.
anmeldung.zurueck_zum_code: Back to the code from the app
anmeldung.faktor_fehlt_titel: The second factor is still missing
anmeldung.faktor_fehlt_text: Setup was interrupted before the app was configured. Let us finish that now.

attrappe.hinweis: Mock-up — invented messages, no mailbox connected

aufgaben.leer_text: Right-click any message and choose “Turn into task”.
aufgaben.laden_ging_nicht: Tasks could not be loaded. They are not gone — the server is not answering right now.

ausgang.leer_text: Everything that was due to go out has been sent.
ausgang.abbrechen_frage: The message will not be sent. Its content will be kept as a draft in the mailbox — nothing is lost.

darstellung.nur_dieses_geraet: These settings apply to this browser only — set them separately on your phone.
darstellung.dichte_hinweis: Compact shows more rows at once.
darstellung.anreisser_hinweis: The first words of the message below the subject.
darstellung.punkte_hinweis: The coloured dot shows which mailbox a message comes from.
darstellung.zeitzone_hinweis: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Leave empty to use the browser's ({{zone}}).
darstellung.gelesen_hinweis: When an opened message counts as read.
darstellung.rueckholen_hinweis: After sending, you have this long to take the message back.
darstellung.wisch_hinweis: Applies in the narrow view: drag a row sideways with your finger.
darstellung.aufraeumen_hinweis: Older messages are deleted for good, on the server as well. Applies to you on every device.
darstellung.bilder_hinweis: These two settings live on the server and apply on every device, unlike the rest of this page. Finding them set differently on a second machine would leave you guessing why one sender knows and another does not.
darstellung.bilder_immer_hinweis: Load images from every sender without asking. Every sender then learns when you opened their message. The images are fetched by nexmail's server, not by your browser, so your address stays hidden.
darstellung.eindunkeln_hinweis: Newsletters almost always bring their own white and sit as a bright slab in a dark window. Switched on, they are inverted rather than recoloured: the distance between text and background stays exactly as it was, and images are turned back. If it goes wrong on one mail, the menu above it switches that one back. Only takes effect in dark mode.

einladung.untertitel: Choose a password for the username {{name}}.
einladung.ungueltig_titel: This invitation is no longer valid
einladung.ungueltig_fallback: Ask the operator for a new invitation.

einrichtung.untertitel: One account to sign in with. It is yours — nexmail asks for this exactly once.
einrichtung.benutzername_hinweis: 3 to 64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen.
einrichtung.anzeigename_optional: Optional. Leave empty to use the user name.
einrichtung.passwort_hinweis: At least 10 characters. No rules about special characters — they demonstrably produce worse passwords, not better ones.
einrichtung.passwort_ungleich: The two entries do not match.
einrichtung.faktor_untertitel: Scan the code with your authenticator app and enter the six digits it shows.
einrichtung.codes_text: These ten codes replace your app if the phone is gone. Each works exactly once. **You will only see them now.**
einrichtung.warnung_text: Without the app and without these codes you can no longer reach your mailboxes. There is an emergency exit (NEXMAIL_2FA_AUS in the compose file), but it requires access to the server.

einstellungen.postfaecher_leer_text: Add your first mailbox and nexmail will fetch your messages.

fenster.nicht_ladbar: The message could not be loaded. It is not gone — the sign-in in this window may have expired.

kalender.absage_text_one: {{count}} person was invited. Without a cancellation, the appointment stays in their calendar.
kalender.absage_text_other: {{count}} people were invited. Without a cancellation, the appointment stays in their calendars.
kalender.aus_einladung: Taken from an invitation. Changes here do not reach the organiser.
kalender.einladen_text_one: {{count}} person will get a message from {{von}}. The appointment is already saved.
kalender.einladen_text_other: {{count}} people will get a message from {{von}}. The appointment is already saved.
kalender.entfernen_gegenstelle: It stays untouched on {{wo}} — nexmail only removes its copy.
kalender.entfernen_sicher_one: The calendar and 1 event will be removed from nexmail.
kalender.entfernen_sicher_other: The calendar and {{count}} events will be removed from nexmail.
kalender.fehler_abo_zu_gross: That file is too large for a subscription.
kalender.fehler_caldav_abgewiesen: User name or password is wrong.
kalender.fehler_caldav_adresse_im_eigenen_netz: Addresses on your own network are blocked.
kalender.fehler_caldav_adresse_ungueltig: That is not a web address.
kalender.fehler_caldav_antwort_unlesbar: The server answered with something nexmail cannot read.
kalender.fehler_caldav_google_api_aus: Google refused the request: the CalDAV API is not enabled in the Cloud project. It is a separate API next to the Google Calendar API — the operator enables it under APIs & Services → Library.
kalender.fehler_caldav_kein_kalenderserver: There is no calendar server at that address.
kalender.fehler_caldav_konflikt: Someone just changed this event elsewhere.
kalender.fehler_caldav_schreiben_gescheitert: The server did not accept the change.
kalender.fehler_kalender_keine_auswahl: Please tick at least one calendar.
kalender.fehler_kalender_nur_lesen: This calendar is a subscription and cannot be changed.
kalender.fehler_kalender_schon_verbunden: This calendar is already connected. A second time would mean every event twice.
kalender.fehler_termin_ende_vor_beginn: The end is before the start.
kalender.fremde_antwort_hinweis: Not applied. Only people on the attendee list can answer — add the address if it belongs here.
kalender.fremde_antwort_kopf_one: A reply from an address that was not invited
kalender.fremde_antwort_kopf_other: {{count}} replies from addresses that were not invited
kalender.gefunden_hinweis: nexmail only fetches the ticked ones. The others stay untouched.
kalender.gesperrt: This calendar is a subscription from {{wo}}. Change it where it is published.
kalender.google_warum: Google only allows CalDAV through OAuth. You would have to create a Google project of your own — that comes later and separately.
kalender.hinzu_abo_text: An ICS link, the kind holiday and fixture lists offer. Always read only.
kalender.hinzu_eigener_text: Lives in nexmail only. For everything that is nowhere else.
kalender.hinzu_verbinden_text: Fetches events from iCloud, Nextcloud or another CalDAV address.
kalender.icloud_hinweis: iCloud needs an app-specific password — the same kind as for a mailbox.
kalender.ics_abgeschnitten: The file held more than is read at once. Read it again and the rest follows.
kalender.ics_einspielen_hinweis: An .ics file from another calendar program. Events that are already here are skipped, so you can safely read the same file again.
kalender.konflikt_geloescht: This event was deleted somewhere else. You can put your version back or cancel.
kalender.konflikt_hinweis: This event was also changed somewhere else since you opened it. nexmail has overwritten nothing yet — decide which version counts.
kalender.laden_fehler: The events could not be loaded.
kalender.leer_text: Create one, or connect an existing one.
kalender.name: Name
kalender.neueinladen_text_one: {{count}} person was already invited and will receive the change from {{von}}.
kalender.neueinladen_text_other: {{count}} people were already invited and will receive the change from {{von}}.
kalender.nur_lesen_hinweis: A subscribed calendar cannot be changed — a published ICS link offers no way back.
kalender.suche_leer_text: No appointment carries this word in its title, location or description. Hidden calendars are not searched.
kalender.suche_mehr: There are more matches than shown here. Narrow the search.
kalender.teilnehmer_hinweis: Everyone listed here gets the invitation. It is only sent after a confirmation when you save.
kalender.umbenennen_frage: What should the calendar be called?
kalender.wdh_fremd: This repetition comes from another program and cannot be edited here. It stays as it is.
kalender.wdh_kein_tag: No day picked — the weekday of the start applies.

kennwort.vergessen_gesendet: If that account exists and has an address stored, the link is on its way. It is valid for two hours.
kennwort.vergessen_hinweis: Enter your username. If an address is stored for that account, a link goes there.

ki.dienst_hinweis: The choice only fills in the address. Any service with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint works, including one not listed here.
ki.ergebnis_hinweis: Check that names, dates and amounts are right. Only “Apply” changes your draft.
ki.erst_einrichten: Enter an access first, then the switch can be turned on.
ki.geht_hinaus: The quote and your signature are not sent along.
ki.gesperrt: The operator has turned AI services off
ki.gesperrt_text: No AI service can be set up in this installation. Ask the operator if you need one.
ki.liste_leeren_frage: All entries are deleted right away. That does not undo what was already sent.
ki.modell_von_hand: This service does not list its models. Enter the name the way the service spells it.
ki.modelle_laden_hinweis: If the list arrives, the address and key are right.
ki.nichts_da: There is no text in the draft yet.
ki.rechtschreibung_text: Typos and punctuation only. Wording and length stay as they are.
ki.rumpf_unlesbar: This entry can no longer be decrypted.
ki.schalter_hinweis: Off by default. While the switch is off, not a word of your mail leaves this server.
ki.schluessel_hinweis: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ki.schluessel_liegt_da: Stored — leave empty to keep it
ki.trennen_frage: The access to {{name}} will be removed, key included. To use it again you have to enter it anew.
ki.uebersetzen_text: The tone stays, the language changes.
ki.vorgaenge_hinweis: Verbatim, as it was sent. Stored encrypted, deleted after {{tage}} days.
ki.warnung: Whatever you have rephrased goes to the address you entered. What happens to it there is in that provider’s terms, not here. If the address points at a machine on your own network, nothing leaves your house.

kontakte.keine_auswahl_text: Pick a contact on the left, or add a new one.
kontakte.name: Name
kontakte.gruppe_keine_kontakte: The address book is empty — add contacts first.
kontakte.gruppe_entfernen_text_leer: "{{name}}" will be removed. The group has no members.
kontakte.gruppe_entfernen_text_one: "{{name}}" will be removed. Its one member stays in the address book.
kontakte.gruppe_entfernen_text_other: "{{name}}" will be removed. Its {{count}} members stay in the address book.

konto.absendername_hinweis: How recipients see you in the message. Leave empty to use the label.
konto.aliase_hinweis: A second address that arrives in the same mailbox. nexmail replies from it automatically when a message was sent there. The address has to exist at your provider — they usually call it an alias or a secondary address. nexmail cannot create one, and the outgoing server rejects any sender address that is not yours.
konto.anmeldung_oauth_hinweis: No password needed — nexmail signs in with the consent you gave.
konto.anzeigename_hinweis: How it is named in the folder column — e.g. Private or Work.
konto.benutzer_verschieden: Incoming and outgoing use different user names here — that is correct for this provider.
konto.entfernen_sicher: Remove mailbox “{{name}}”? The messages on the server stay untouched.
konto.erkannt: Provider recognised: {{name}}. Server settings are filled in.
konto.farbe_hinweis: nexmail assigns it automatically from a checked palette.
konto.fehler_intern: Error inside nexmail — see the log
konto.gefunden_autoconfig: Supplied by the provider ({{name}}). Server settings are filled in.
konto.gefunden_tabelle: From the built-in list ({{name}}). Server settings are filled in.
konto.icloud_benutzer_hinweis: Apple wants only the name part for incoming mail and the full address for outgoing. nexmail fills in both correctly.
konto.icloud_hinweis_text: Your usual Apple password is refused by iCloud, with the very same message as a typo. Create an app-specific password on account.apple.com and enter that one here.
konto.kalender_mit_entfernen_one: Remove this account's calendar as well
konto.kalender_mit_entfernen_other: Remove this account's {{count}} calendars as well
konto.kein_postfach_text: Add your first mailbox and nexmail will fetch your messages.
konto.nichts_gefunden: Nobody supplies settings for this address. Enter them by hand below — that works with any IMAP mailbox.
konto.passwort_liegt_vor: Stored. Click to change — nexmail cannot display it.
konto.passwort_unveraendert: Leave empty — the stored password is kept.
konto.tags_hinweis: Groups the mailboxes in the folder column. Enter or comma adds one.
konto.ungeprueft: These values are unverified. If the test fails, check your provider’s instructions.

lesen.bilder_geblockt: Images in this message were not loaded. They would tell the sender when you opened it.
lesen.bilder_immer_gemerkt: Images from {{adresse}} will always be loaded from now on.
lesen.bilder_ging_nicht: The images could not be loaded. The sender's server did not answer.
lesen.wichtig_niedrig: This message was sent with low importance.

liste.leer_text: There is no message in this folder.
liste.keine_auswahl_text: Pick a message on the left to read it.
liste.gruppiert_hinweis: Group related messages into a single row.

oauth.untertitel: Neither accepts a password over IMAP any more. For nexmail to reach them you need your own app registration with them — nexmail cannot ship one, because the key would sit in public source code.
oauth.produktion_warnung: With Google the app must be set to “In production”, not “Testing”. In testing the access expires after seven days, and it then looks like a broken mail server. Without Google's review you get a warning screen when consenting — click through it.
oauth.adresse_fehlt: Set the public address under Server first.
oauth.mandant_hinweis: “common” for everyone, “organizations” for work accounts only, or your tenant ID.
oauth.laden_fehler: The settings could not be loaded.
oauth.fehler_oauth_art_unbekannt: nexmail does not know that provider.
oauth.anleitung_google: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen and Credentials. App type “Web application”, scopes for Gmail and Calendar, and the redirect URI below.
oauth.anleitung_microsoft: Entra admin center → App registrations → New registration. Platform “Web”, the redirect URI below, then create a secret under “Certificates & secrets”.
oauth.zugaenge_text: Consents you have given. nexmail uses them for mailbox and calendar alike — consenting once is enough.
oauth.nicht_eingerichtet: The operator has to register an app first (Administration → Google and Microsoft).
oauth.trennen_text: nexmail forgets its tokens. With the provider itself the permission stays — revoke it there in your own account.
oauth.fehler_oauth_zustimmung_abgelaufen: The consent no longer applies. Please reconnect.
oauth.fehler_oauth_anbieter_fehlt: The operator has not registered an app for this yet.
oauth.fehler_oauth_kein_refresh: The provider did not grant lasting access. With Google: set the app to “In production” and connect again.
oauth.fehler_oauth_abgewiesen: The provider refused. Are client ID and secret right?
oauth.fehler_anlauf_fehlt: The attempt timed out. Please try again.
oauth.anleitung_dauer: Once, about ten minutes. Then never again.
oauth.g1_text: Open console.cloud.google.com, use the project picker at the top, “New project”. The name does not matter much — it shows up in the consent window later, “nexmail” works.
oauth.g2_text: APIs & Services → Library. Search for and enable “Gmail API”, “Google Calendar API” and “CalDAV API” in turn. ⚠️ The CalDAV API is a separate one: without it Google refuses every calendar request with 403, and that looks like a missing consent.
oauth.g3_text: App name, your address as support contact, your address as developer contact. User type “External” — “Internal” only exists with Google Workspace.
oauth.g4_text: Add these three: https://mail.google.com/ (mailbox), .../auth/calendar (calendar) and .../auth/userinfo.email (only so nexmail knows which account was connected).
oauth.g5_text: Type “Web application”. Under “Authorised redirect URIs” paste the address below — literally; one character off and Google answers with “redirect_uri_mismatch”.
oauth.g6_text: Click “Publish app”; the status must be “In production”. ⚠️ If it stays on “Testing”, access expires after seven days. You do not need Google's review — for fewer than 100 users the warning screen you click through is enough.
oauth.g7_titel: Client ID and secret go here
oauth.g7_text: Both are shown under “Clients” for the entry you just created. Enter them below and save. Connecting is then done by each person under Settings → Security.
oauth.localhost_hinweis: A localhost address works for trying it out. Google never calls the redirect itself — it only sends your browser there, and your browser can reach localhost. For http, localhost is an explicit exception.
oauth.trennen_haengt_dran: Whatever depends on this consent goes with it: {{was}}. Those messages will then only exist at the provider.
oauth.nicht_eingerichtet_benutzer: Google and Microsoft accounts are not available yet — the operator has to register the app first.
oauth.fehler_oauth_zugang_unbekannt: That consent no longer exists here. Connect the account again.

oidc.was_ist_das: Sign in through an external provider — Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia. While this list is empty nothing changes: no buttons, no open endpoints.
oidc.entfernen_text: “{{name}}” will be removed. Anyone who only signs in through it will be locked out; existing links stay but lead nowhere.
oidc.anzeigename_hinweis: This is what the sign-in page shows.
oidc.kuerzel_hinweis: Lowercase, digits, dash. It is part of the redirect URI.
oidc.geheimnis_liegt_vor: A secret is stored. Leaving this empty means: unchanged.
oidc.scopes_hinweis: “openid” is added automatically. “email” is what matches existing accounts.
oidc.aktiv_hinweis: Disabled removes more than the button — the route itself is closed.
oidc.konto_anlegen_hinweis: Someone who signs in without an account here gets one. Only enable this if not just anyone can register with that provider.
oidc.keine_adresse: Set the public address on the “Server” tab first — otherwise there is no redirect URI.
oidc.fehler_oidc_abgelehnt: The provider refused the sign-in, or you cancelled.
oidc.fehler_oidc_kein_konto: There is no nexmail account for this sign-in.
oidc.fehler_oidc_anlauf_fehlt: The attempt expired. Please try again.
oidc.fehler_allgemein: Signing in through the provider did not work.
oidc.fehler_oidc_ausweis: The provider’s ID token could not be verified.
oidc.fehler_oidc_falscher_aussteller: The provider calls itself something other than what is configured. The two have to match.
oidc.fehler_oidc_fremd_verknuepft: That identity already belongs to a different nexmail account.
oidc.fehler_oidc_kein_anbieter: The provider’s discovery document is unreachable.
oidc.fehler_oidc_kein_anmeldeendpunkt: The provider names no authorization endpoint.
oidc.fehler_oidc_kein_ausweis: The provider returned no ID token. Usually the “openid” scope is missing.
oidc.fehler_oidc_kein_json: The provider answered unreadably. Usually a proxy or an error page sits in front of it.
oidc.fehler_oidc_kein_token_endpunkt: The provider names no token endpoint.
oidc.fehler_oidc_keine_adresse: Without a public address there is no redirect URI. It lives in the administration under “Server”.
oidc.fehler_oidc_keine_schluessel: The provider’s keys could not be read.
oidc.fehler_oidc_tausch: The provider refused the exchange. Usually the client id, the secret or the redirect URI is wrong.

ordner.leeren_sicher: Empty “{{name}}” for good? This cannot be undone.
ordner.neu_frage: What should the folder be called?
ordner.neu_frage_unter: What should the subfolder in "{{name}}" be called?
ordner.entfernen_sicher: {{name}} will be deleted on the server, along with all {{count}} messages in it. This cannot be undone.
ordner.name: Name
ordner.umbenennen_hinweis: Subfolders are renamed along with it.
ordner.fremdes_postfach: IMAP cannot move messages between mailboxes. Forward the message instead.

postfachneu.hinzufuegen_text: Where does the mailbox come from?
postfachneu.weg_imap_text: Any ordinary mailbox — enter the address, nexmail looks up the rest.
postfachneu.weg_google_text: Gmail and Google Workspace. Mailbox and calendar in one go.
postfachneu.weg_microsoft_text: Outlook.com and Microsoft 365. Calendar to follow.
postfachneu.zustimmung_google: nexmail sends you to Google. You sign in there and allow access to your mailbox and calendar. Then you come back here.
postfachneu.zustimmung_microsoft: nexmail sends you to Microsoft. You sign in there and allow access to your mailbox. Then you come back here.
postfachneu.legt_an: Creating the mailbox and reading the folders …
postfachneu.keine_serverdaten: Nobody publishes server settings for this address. Enter them by hand under “IMAP and SMTP” — the consent is offered there in the list.
postfachneu.kalender_frage: Which calendars should nexmail take along?
postfachneu.kalender_keine: There is no calendar under this account.
postfachneu.zugaenge_nicht_geladen: The consents you have given could not be loaded. Is nexmail still running? A second attempt usually does it.

protokoll.faellt_zurueck: Falls back to Normal on its own at {{zeit}}.
protokoll.durch_umgebung: The level is set in NEXMAIL_LOG_STUFE and cannot be changed here.
protokoll.was_nicht_drinsteht: The log holds no passwords, no message contents and no full addresses — it is meant to be shareable.
protokoll.leeren_sicher: All lines are removed. Already downloaded copies are unaffected.

push.buendeln_hinweis: If a round fetches several messages, you get one notification with the count instead of five separate ones.
push.geraet_hinweis: Permission belongs to the browser, not to your account. Grant it once on every device where you want notifications.
push.geraete_hinweis: Each browser registers once. An entry you remove here stops receiving immediately. If you clear your browser data instead, the server drops it on the next attempt.
push.ios_hinweis: Apple only delivers notifications to sites on the home screen. Without that step the button above does nothing, and Safari does not say why.
push.keine_antwort: The browser neither allowed nor denied the request. On an iPhone this happens when nexmail was not opened from the home screen.
push.lage_abgelehnt_hinweis: nexmail cannot ask again. The permission lives in the browser's site settings, usually behind the padlock in the address bar.
push.lage_abgemeldet_hinweis: You removed this device from the list. Nothing arrives here until you sign it back on — the browser's permission still stands, one click is enough.
push.lage_bereit_hinweis: A test notification tells you whether anything actually arrives.
push.lage_erlaubt_ohne_anmeldung_hinweis: The browser may show notifications, but this server does not know the device. That happens after a move, after clearing browser data, or when nexmail was set up again. One click catches it up, without asking anyone twice.
push.lage_kein_home: Add nexmail to the home screen first
push.lage_kein_home_hinweis: Apple only delivers notifications to sites that live there. Use Share, "Add to Home Screen", then open nexmail from there and allow it here.
push.lage_offen_hinweis: The browser asks once. Say no there and nexmail cannot ask again: you can only undo it in the browser's site settings.
push.lage_unmoeglich_hinweis: It is missing either the service worker or the push interface. A current Firefox, Chrome, Edge or Safari has both.
push.mail_hinweis: Only what the sync really fetched, and only after the rules have run. A mailbox's first sync notifies about nothing.
push.nur_ungelesen_hinweis: Mail you already read on your phone will not notify you again on your computer.
push.ordner_alle: All folders except junk and trash
push.ordner_alle_hinweis: Snoozed mail stays quiet regardless: you put it aside on purpose.
push.ordner_posteingang_hinweis: Anything a rule filed into the archive or junk stays quiet.
push.ruhezeit_hinweis: Nothing is notified during this period. Reminders with no lead time still come through, because that is the event itself. What is dropped is not delivered later.
push.termine_hinweis: The lead time is set on the event. What reaches you here is not shown again inside the open app.
push.wobei_hinweis: This applies to your account, so it is the same on every device.

regeln.leer_text: A rule sorts mail before you see it.
regeln.name: Name
regeln.postfach_hinweis: Leave empty so the rule applies to every mailbox.
regeln.stopp_hinweis: If this rule matches, the rules below it are not checked. Without this a later rule can move the message somewhere else again.
regeln.inhalt_hinweis: “Body” only searches the preview text and messages you have already opened — not your whole mailbox.

schlagworte.neu_text: The name is stored on the mailbox as an IMAP keyword and shows up in other apps too. Umlauts and special characters are rewritten for that.
schlagworte.name: Name
schlagworte.leer_text: Create one here — or set it right on a message, via the list’s context menu.
schlagworte.umbenennen_hinweis: Only the display name changes. The keyword “{{atom}}” stays on the mail server — other apps keep showing that form.
schlagworte.entfernen_sicher: “{{name}}” will be removed from {{count}} messages nexmail knows about, then deleted.
schlagworte.entfernen_hinweis: Messages nexmail has never synced keep the keyword on the server.
schlagworte.fehler_nicht_unterstuetzt: This mailbox does not allow custom tags — the mail server only accepts its system flags.
schlagworte.fehler_veraltet: The folder was rebuilt on the mail server. nexmail is re-syncing it — try again in a moment.
schlagworte.fehler_name_vergeben: A tag with this name already exists.
schlagworte.fehler_name_leer: The name must not be empty.

serverfehler.abo_adresse_fehlt: Without an address there is nothing to subscribe to.
serverfehler.abo_zu_gross: The file is too large for a calendar.
serverfehler.absender_abgelehnt: The outgoing server refused the sender address {{absender}}. Usually it does not belong to the account nexmail signs in with.
serverfehler.absender_fehlt: No server accepts mail without a sender address.
serverfehler.abwesenheit_datum_ungueltig: That date is unusable. Expected YYYY-MM-DD.

sicherheit.alle_beenden_sicher: All other sessions become invalid immediately. This device stays signed in.
sicherheit.anbieter_hinweis: Link your account to a provider to sign in through it. Your password keeps working.
sicherheit.codes_knapp: With none left and the phone gone, only the emergency switch in the compose file helps.
sicherheit.faktor_aus_frage: We need your password to turn it off.
sicherheit.faktor_aus_warnung: After that, all your mailboxes hang on your password alone. If nexmail is reachable from the internet, leave it on.
sicherheit.faktor_empfehlung: Without a second factor, your password alone opens all your mailboxes. On your own network that is defensible — reachable from the internet it is not.
sicherheit.kontaktadresse_fehlt: No address is stored. Without one there is no way back if you forget your password.
sicherheit.kontaktadresse_hinweis: This is where the link goes if you forget your password. Deliberately not one of your mailboxes: you should be able to reach it even when you cannot get in here.

sicherungen.einleitung: The list below holds restore points: complete copies next to the database, for a failed update or a contact deleted by mistake. “Download” turns one into a real backup — encrypted and without messages, because those are still in the mailbox on the server.
sicherungen.warnung_volume: If the disk dies, the restore points die with it. It only becomes a backup once it leaves this machine.
sicherungen.behalten_hinweis: How many restore points stay. Older ones are removed — the ones made before an update count too.
sicherungen.leer_text: One is made automatically before any change to the database. Create your own with “Create now”.
sicherungen.ladefehler: The list could not be loaded.
sicherungen.anlegen_text: A copy of the current state. It stays on this machine — download it afterwards to take it with you.
sicherungen.herunterladen_text: The archive is encrypted and holds mailboxes, contacts, rules, signatures, tasks and the key — but no messages. nexmail fetches those from the server again after a restore.
sicherungen.passwort_warnung: Without this password the archive cannot be opened — not by us either. Write it down where you will find it when it matters.
sicherungen.entfernen_text: The copy from {{wann}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
sicherungen.einspielen_text: Pick a downloaded archive and enter its password. The next step shows what would happen — nothing is touched until then.
sicherungen.folgen: This replaces the entire state: users, mailboxes, contacts, rules. Every signed-in device is signed out, including this one — and the password from the backup applies again, not the current one.
sicherungen.adresse_anders: The public address is a different one
sicherungen.adresse_erklaerung: nexmail builds invitation links and the sign-in redirect from it. Which one should apply?
sicherungen.adresse_neu_folge: The address you are using right now. Correct if nexmail has moved.
sicherungen.adresse_alt_folge: The one from the archive. Correct if this is the same installation — then nothing changes.
sicherungen.oidc_text: The redirect URI is registered with the provider, not here — nexmail cannot change it there. If the address has changed, it has to read like this:
sicherungen.fertig_text: The state from the backup is in place. You are signed out — sign in with the password that belongs to this backup. nexmail fetches the messages from the server afterwards.

signaturen.leer_text: A block of text that goes under your mail.
signaturen.name: Name
signaturen.postfach_hinweis: Empty means: every mailbox without its own signature.
signaturen.standard_hinweis: This signature is already in the message when you start writing. Only one signature per mailbox can do that.

stoerung.stamm: Your mailboxes could not be loaded. They are not gone — the server is not answering right now.
stoerung.zugangsdaten: The mail server rejects the credentials: {{namen}}.
stoerung.zugangsdaten_folge: No new mail arrives there until the password is right.

suche.nur_zwischenspeicher: Subject and sender searched in full — message text only where it was already fetched.

termin.kein_kalender: Replying tells the organiser. The event only reaches your calendar once you add it.
termin.fremde_zeitzone: Time zone “{{zone}}” is unknown here. The time is shown exactly as the invitation stated it.
termin.fehler: The reply could not be sent.
termin.uebernehmen_fehler: The event could not be added.
termin.kein_ziel: You need a calendar for that first.

textvorlagen.hinweis: Recurring replies you insert while writing — via the Template menu in the compose window.
textvorlagen.leer_text: A building block you insert at the cursor while writing.
textvorlagen.name: Name
textvorlagen.fehler_name_vergeben: A template with this name already exists.
textvorlagen.laden_ging_nicht: Templates could not be loaded. They are not gone — the server is not answering right now.
textvorlagen.ziehen: Drag to change the order in the Template menu.

ueber.aktuell: You are on the latest version.
ueber.taeglich_nachsehen_text: Ask GitHub once a day whether a newer version has been released.
ueber.was_hinausgeht: This is the only place where nexmail reaches out on its own — everything else ships inside the image, down to the fonts. All that leaves is the question about the latest version: no addresses, no settings, no subject lines. Switched off, the button next to it still works.
ueber.schriften_text: They ship inside the image rather than being fetched from Google. A mail client that phones home the moment you open it would be hard to justify — it blocks tracking pixels in other people's mail, after all.

umzug.ein_text: An mbox file from Thunderbird or another program. Anything already in the folder is skipped — an interrupted import can simply be repeated.
umzug.ein_dauer: With ten thousand messages this takes a while. You can close this window — nexmail keeps importing as long as it is running.
umzug.ein_ohne_kennung_one: 1 message without a Message-ID — nexmail cannot tell whether it was already there.
umzug.ein_ohne_kennung_other: {{count}} messages without a Message-ID — nexmail cannot tell whether they were already there.
umzug.ein_abgeschnitten: The limit of {{count}} messages per run has been reached. Importing the same file again continues from there.
umzug.ein_abgebrochen: Cancelled. What is already in stays in — a second run skips it.
umzug.aus_text: What gets downloaded is what nexmail knows about this folder.
umzug.aus_luecke: nexmail only knows {{bekannt}} of {{gesamt}} messages in this folder. Please sync first — otherwise the rest is missing from the file.
umzug.aus_mbox: mbox — one file, Thunderbird reads it
umzug.aus_zip_zu_gross: A ZIP holds at most {{grenze}} messages. This folder has more — mbox has no limit.
umzug.aus_leer: There is nothing in this folder to download.

verfassen.vorlagen_leer: No templates yet — create them under Settings → Signatures.
verfassen.vorlagen_fehler: Templates could not be loaded — click to retry.
verfassen.im_ausgang: Not sent yet — the message is in the outbox and will be retried. ({{grund}})
verfassen.entwurf_fehler: The draft could not be stored. This window stays open so the text is not lost.
verfassen.anhang_frage_text: The text mentions an attachment, but nothing is attached. Send anyway?

verwaltung.benutzer_entfernen_kurz: {{name}} will be removed with all their data. Nothing changes on the mail server.
verwaltung.benutzer_entfernen_text: {{name}} will be removed — along with {{postfaecher}} mailboxes and {{nachrichten}} messages, plus contacts, rules and signatures. Nothing changes on the mail server; nexmail only forgets.
verwaltung.benutzer_text: Add and manage additional users. The database and tests have been prepared since stage 0 — only this screen is missing.
verwaltung.einladung_adresse_hinweis: Where the invitation goes — a mailbox they already have.
verwaltung.einladung_benutzername_hinweis: They sign in with this. It cannot be changed later.
verwaltung.einladung_zuruecknehmen_text: The link for “{{name}}” will stop working. You can invite again at any time.
verwaltung.gilt_fuer_alle: These values apply to the whole application, not just to you.
verwaltung.kein_postausgang: nexmail has no outgoing mail server of its own, so it cannot send the invitation. It is on the “Server” tab.
verwaltung.keine_adresse: No public address is set. The link in the invitation would lead nowhere. It is on the “Server” tab.
verwaltung.ki_hinweis: While this is off, no user can set up or use an AI service — not even with a key of their own. Off by default, because otherwise text from mail goes to a foreign server without you finding out.
verwaltung.nur_betreiber_text: This page administers the whole application. Your own settings are top right under your name.
verwaltung.oeffentliche_adresse_hinweis: The address nexmail is reachable at from outside. Needed for links in mail.
verwaltung.oidc_text: Sign in via authentik, Keycloak and others. The database has room for it; it is not built yet.
verwaltung.postausgang_hinweis: This is how nexmail sends mail of its own — today, the invitations. Better not your private mailbox.
verwaltung.postausgang_liegt_vor: A password is stored. Leaving this empty means: unchanged.
verwaltung.uebergeben_text: After this {{wer}} runs nexmail and you do not. You will only get back in if {{wer}} hands it back. Enter your password to confirm.
verwaltung.untertitel: What belongs to the application and applies to every user.
verwaltung.zeitzone_hinweis: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Applies to every user. Empty means the browser’s.

wiedervorlage.eigen_text: The message moves to the “Wiedervorlage” folder and returns unread at the chosen time.
wiedervorlage.vergangen: That time is in the past.
wiedervorlage.fehler_ohne_kennung: This message has no Message-ID, so it cannot be snoozed.
wiedervorlage.fehler_kennung_unbrauchbar: This message's Message-ID contains characters that cannot be searched reliably — it cannot be snoozed.
wiedervorlage.fehler_ordner: The snooze folder could not be created on the server.
